title: What I can build for you
intro: I help businesses turn the open web into clean data and working automations — from resilient scrapers and lead lists to LinkedIn/social workflows, n8n pipelines and ML. Below are the platforms I've built scrapers and automations for.

offerings.title: Web scraping at scale
offerings.desc: Resilient scrapers for e-commerce, social and SaaS — pagination, anti-bot handling, and exports to Google Sheets, a CMS, or webhooks.

offerings.title: Lead generation
offerings.desc: Targeted B2B lead lists with enriched, verified contact data — emails, phones and social profiles, deduplicated and ready to use.

offerings.title: LinkedIn & social automation
offerings.desc: Profile and company data extraction plus outreach workflows across LinkedIn and other social platforms.

offerings.title: n8n & RTILA workflows
offerings.desc: Low-code/no-code automations wired to your existing tools — triggers, enrichment, and hand-offs that run on a schedule.

offerings.title: Data, ETL & ML
offerings.desc: Cleaning, normalization and deduplication, dashboards, and machine-learning models with clear, explainable results.

offerings.title: Custom tools & apps
offerings.desc: Packaged desktop and web tools — installers, dashboards and internal apps that put the data to work.
